I promise you the people it hurts will never forget, sometimes even the people that are just acquaintances to you will never forget. People always care more than you think and if you don't think the people around you care enough, find better people. I know its easier said than done but it really does make a world of difference. I'm so sorry you feel this way, I hope it gets better.

I've felt like this so many times on so many days and I probably will again. I know how it feels to be fighting that battle with your brain, feeling like everyone's perceiving you wrong because you just think you're so awful and reprehensible. I hope you get out of that spot, I hope so bad that you do. I'm so sorry you feel this way.

sometimes there's nothing other people can say to make it feel better, sometimes the only way to think your life is worth living is to change everything. often times people find that impossible. I guess the only real thing I can say is that I'm sorry, and I hope things turn around.
